title: Inheritance adds to a class
summary: Inheritance lets one class extend another. The child class receives methods from its parent.
introduction: Inheritance lets one class extend another. The child class receives methods from its parent. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain inheritance adds to a class
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Use inheritance only when the child really is a kind of the parent.
